text:
Alex (AE): Need an exec bridge — AcmeCorp POC is blocked. They require BYOK KMS attestation + SAML SSO (with SCIM) + a 99.9% latency commit <200ms. Legal is also asking for a pricing commitment for the POC. Can someone join an exec call tomorrow 9am PT? @Seth
Mira (SE): On it. Quick Qs: are they planning Hosted or Dedicated? Hosted + BYOK is not supported natively, right? And what's expected traffic for the POC?
Alex (AE): They want Hosted for speed but insist on BYOK. POC volume ~20k req/day, peak ~25 qps. They're asking for 30% off for the POC and EU-only data residency.
Jamal (Solutions Eng): Short tech take: Hosted + BYOK is non-standard. Options:
 - Hosted: no native BYOK. Possible sidecar/proxy approach but needs infra work. (3-4w)
 - Dedicated/Private: supports BYOK, provisioning + KMS integration ~5-7 business days.
SAML+SCIM is fine. Latency SLO depends on Dedicated sizing; 2x suitable GPUs should hit <200ms for that qps.
Priya (Eng-Infra): If we choose Dedicated, provisioning + KMS setup is 5-7 biz days. Need signed PO/account commit before we spin up env. Hosted workaround will take 3-4 weeks of engineering.
Ingrid (Legal): Legal needs details on the "pricing for POC" ask. We typically avoid fixed discounts for short POCs. Can offer trial credit + discount on committed contract. Also need to confirm EU data residency and get the security questionnaire. Send customer contact + any redlines.
Alex (AE): Contact: lucas@acmecorp.com (CTO). They've sent a full security questionnaire and want a written BYOK attestation for Hosted. @Mira can you triage blockers from the questionnaire?
Mira (SE): I'll triage tonight and surface true blockers. @Jamal can you draft a succinct note on BYOK options I can share with CTO? I'll also make a 2-slide exec ask for tomorrow.
Jamal (Solutions Eng): Drafting now. Snippet for outreach:
```
Hosted: NO native BYOK. Options:
1) Short-term: customer-managed keys via sidecar proxy (engineering change, ~3-4w).
2) Preferred: Dedicated/Private with BYOK (5-7 business days to provision).
```
Seth (VP Sales): :raising_hand: I'll join the exec call tomorrow 9am PT. Decision point: Dedicated (requires PO) vs Hosted workaround. For pricing we can offer up to 20% POC discount + $25k trial credit. Anything beyond needs CRO approval.
Alex (AE): Customer pushing 30% + Hosted BYOK. Are we good with 20% + trial credit?
Ingrid (Legal): 20% + trial credit is okay. Legal will draft a conversion clause: if they don't convert within 90 days, discount is recouped (conversion credit). Will circulate suggested language.
Priya (Eng-Infra): Ops note: if we promise 99.9% <200ms on Dedicated for their load, we need SLA exceptions for burst traffic. Also need their network team to enable VPC peering in EU region.
Alex (AE): I'll confirm VPC peering contact. @sre-bot please create a ticket to provision Dedicated env + KMS path, priority P1.
sre-bot: Ticket created: INF-4821 - Dedicated env + BYOK path. ETA: 5 business days. Owners: Priya, Jamal.
Mira (SE): Exec ask slides prepped and linked (link to drive). Quick run-through in 30m? @Seth
Seth (VP Sales): 30m works. We'll pick approach on the call. If Dedicated is chosen, get procurement ready to issue PO immediately.
Alex (AE): I'll send calendar invite to Acme for 9am PT and update after the call. Thanks all.
